items.name: Integrated Tactical Reality Ripper
items.description:
This sleek rifle converts energy into projectiles of concentrated magic that tears apart matter by destroying its bindings to the reality. A reality ripper is modular and has two modes: destructive and reaping. While in destructive mode, the reality ripper deals acid damage and gains the razing trait. While in reaping mode, a reality ripper deals void damage and gains the concussive trait.

A realty ripper's minimum weapon improvement is tactical, meaning its tracking +1 cannot be removed, though further improvements can be still applied.

generalAbilities.name: Networked Nodocite
generalAbilities.description: A nodocite can communicate wirelessly with other nodocites within 200 feet.

defensiveAbilities.name: Warpwave
defensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A creature targets the nodocite gunner with an attack

Effect The nodocite gunner warps reality around itself, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Assess Target
offensiveAbilities.description: The nodocite gunner assesses a target within 200 feet and pinpoints gaps in their defenses. Until the end of the nodocite gunner's turn, they deal an additional 1d8 damage with their reality ripper against the Assessed Target and increase the range increment of their reality ripper to 80 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Reality Cage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The nodocite guardian bends reality to trap one Medium or smaller creature within 60 feet in a cage of warped reality. The target must attempt a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected, and the reality cage fails to form.

Success The target is hindered by reality shards, becoming Off-Guard for 1 round; the reality cage fails to form.

Failure The target is trapped in a reality cage that lasts 1d4 rounds.

Critical Failure The target is trapped in a reality cage that lasts 1 minute. A reality cage has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 10 Hit Points (BT 5). A creature trapped in a reality cage is Immobilized (Escape DC 20). A reality cage provides lesser cover.
